description: Manual invoice processing with clear automation potential

input.name: Invoice Processing
input.description: Invoices are received by email, manually entered into the accounting system, matched against purchase orders, approved by department managers, and scheduled for payment. The process involves 3 departments and takes an average of 8 business days.
input.inputData: PDF invoices via email, purchase orders in ERP, approval chain through email, payment scheduling in accounting software. Monthly volume: 500 invoices.
input.goal: Reduce processing time to under 3 business days and eliminate manual data entry errors.

input.name: Digital Customer Onboarding
input.description: Fully digital onboarding flow: customer fills online form, automated ID verification via API, instant account creation, welcome email with credentials, self-service configuration wizard. Average time: 15 minutes.
input.inputData: Online registration form, ID verification API (98% success rate), automated email system, self-service portal. Monthly volume: 200 new customers.
input.goal: Maintain current speed while improving completion rate from 85% to 95%.
